ai_summary: PAN Card (Permanent Account Number) is a central government service under Income Tax Department in the Finance category, available online.
ai_explanation: PAN Card (Permanent Account Number) is PAN is a 10-character alphanumeric identifier issued for all tax-related and high-value financial transactions. Eligibility: Individuals, companies, HUFs, and entities carrying out financial transactions in India.. Benefits: Mandatory for filing income tax returns, opening bank accounts, and high-value transactions.. You can apply online via https://www.incometax.gov.in. Processing time is typically e-PAN via Aadhaar: instant to 10 minutes; physical card: 15 days. and fees are Instant e-PAN free; regular PAN Rs.93 (Indian address) + GST..
eligibility_summary: Individuals, companies, HUFs, and entities carrying out financial transactions in India.
